title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Fry bacon. Beat eggs with parmesan. Combine all and season with black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. Grill until cooked. In a pan, sauté onion, add tomato puree, cream, and cooked chicken. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
summary: Rich and moist chocolate cake perfect for dessert lovers.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs and melted butter. Bake for 25-30 minutes.
